ownership_policy.path_syntax: Exact repository-relative files, or trailing /** for the named task subtree only. No other glob syntax.
ownership_policy.activation: Assigned roles may independently research, implement, test, commit on task branches and open draft PRs. Unfinished approval/documentation dependencies allow reversible provisional work; technical prerequisites and evidence requirements remain mandatory.
ownership_policy.coordination: Each task owner records its implementation result in its own checkpoint and task-branch registry entry; do not change another task's result. Shared-ledger integration is asynchronous. Chat 00 availability is not required to execute or finish assigned work.
ownership_policy.handoff: Record path changes or transfers in task checkpoint/PR; respect active owners. Prior inactive reservations may be reconciled with explicit owner instructions. Cross-task conflicts need deliberate integration, not concurrent overwrites.
ownership_policy.limits: At most eight changed paths and 1500 source lines per response, including work within reserved subtrees.
ownership_policy.unallocated_paths: Use assigned task paths and explicit owner-authorized role scope; record bounded additions in the task checkpoint/PR. Do not overwrite another active task's files.
ownership_policy.ledger_updates: Task-branch registry status updates for one's own task are shared administrative metadata, not a claim of exclusive registry ownership; preserve other entries. Resolve cross-branch edits before integration.
